products.name: Rainout Reschedule Coordinator
products.product: A focused sports league rainout rescheduling workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: community sports leagues and small tournament operators
products.problem: A field closure changes games, teams, officials, facilities, standings, and family communications, but coordinators often update each dependency separately.
products.valueProposition: Turns sports league rainout rescheduling into a visible operating queue so every weather-affected game is canceled, relocated, or rescheduled with all dependent assignments and communications reconciled.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets sports rainout rescheduling, league weather cancellation, makeup game scheduler, and field closure communication searches.

products.name: Official Assignment Acceptance
products.product: A focused sports official assignment acceptance tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: community sports leagues and small tournament operators
products.problem: Referee and umpire assignments may be sent by text or email without a durable acceptance, qualification check, conflict review, or replacement path.
products.valueProposition: Turns sports official assignment acceptance tracking into a visible operating queue so every game has the required qualified officials who explicitly accept and receive the current assignment details.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets referee assignment software, sports official scheduling, umpire acceptance tracker, and referee coverage board searches.
